description: This file is a React component (CompactExecutionHeader) used for rendering a compact header for workflow execution details in a web application's UI. It imports UI components, utility functions, and types; defines helper formatting functions; and renders UI elements such as status indicators, IDs, workflow info, durations, sizes, retries, and VC badges.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Formats a duration in milliseconds into a human-readable string, handling cases for milliseconds, seconds, and minutes.

methods.name: formatBytes
methods.description: Converts a byte size into a human-readable string with appropriate units.

methods.name: truncateId
methods.description: Truncates an ID string to show the first 8 and last 4 characters, separated by ellipsis.
